task: Generate one photorealistic still frame from a casual vertical video someone recorded with an iPhone: the CUMBRE bag standing on his home desk next to the steaming matte black mug in soft morning light. It will be the first frame of a short B-roll clip, so it must feel candid and authentic, like a frame from an everyday phone video, not a stock photo or an ad. Attached image 1 is the exact product: replicate it identically (same bottle shape, size, materials, colors, label design and label text), as described in "product". Attached image 2 only shows the place: match its location and light, but do not include the person from it.

output.look: raw, unedited iPhone video frame, not a professional photo

subject: the CUMBRE bag upright, sealed, label and mountain drawing facing the camera and fully visible, with the steaming matte black mug beside it; no person

product.name: CUMBRE specialty ground coffee, 340 g bag (a fictional brand)
product.bag: a stand-up coffee pouch (doypack) with a flat bottom gusset, about 22 cm tall and 13 cm wide (roughly the length of an adult open hand), made of matte coffee-black paper (#16110D) with a smooth, non-glossy finish, no window, standing upright, filled and naturally creased
product.top: the top edge is heat-sealed straight across, with a thin solid copper (#C8833A) strip along the seal
product.label: printed directly on the front of the bag, centered in its upper-middle part, flat matte print, no paper sticker
product.artwork: above the text, a minimalist mountain drawn with only a few thin copper (#C8833A) lines: one continuous outline of two overlapping peaks, the taller one in the center, no fill, no shading, no sun, no other shapes
product.label_text: exactly two centered lines of text and nothing else: 'CUMBRE' in large, tall, condensed cream (#F3EBDD) sans-serif capital letters (Oswald style), and below it 'CAFÉ DE ALTURA' in small copper (#C8833A) sans-serif capital letters with wide letter spacing; no other words or numbers, and no graphics besides the thin-line mountain
product.rule: the product must look exactly like this in every image: same shape, proportions, colors, materials, mountain drawing, label design and label text

environment.location: the same home office desk as in the reference image, morning
environment.details: the wooden desk, the closed paper notebook and pen, the edge of the closed laptop, the small plant, the window softly out of focus
environment.atmosphere: real, lived-in and slightly imperfect, like a real everyday place, not a staged set or a showroom

camera.device: iPhone main camera, handheld, at a natural human height
camera.framing: handheld vertical shot at desk height, the bag and mug in the upper-middle of the frame, the lower third of the frame calm and empty (the desk surface) to leave room for an on-screen button
camera.focus: natural phone depth of field, no artificial heavy bokeh
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight phone sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft morning daylight from the window behind the camera, evenly lighting the front of the bag
lighting.mood: natural and realistic, low contrast, accurate colors, no dramatic lighting

realism_rules: must look like an ordinary frame from a phone video, not AI-generated and not a stock photo
small real-world imperfections: light dust, slight wear, small scratches, uneven surfaces, a few things slightly out of place
nothing too clean, too glossy or perfectly symmetrical
if hands or skin appear: real skin texture with pores and fine lines, correct anatomy, five fingers
negative: any text other than the product label (CUMBRE / CAFÉ DE ALTURA), captions, subtitles, other logos or brand names, watermarks, UI elements, readable signs or screens
a different bottle, a changed or blank label, misspelled label text, extra products, a second bottle
CGI, 3D render, illustration, overly glossy or plastic surfaces, futuristic or sci-fi look
stock photo look, advertising look, studio lighting, cinematic color grading, HDR, oversaturated colors, heavy bokeh
perfect symmetry, empty sterile spaces, everything brand new
deformed hands, extra fingers, warped objects
recognizable faces, a likeness of any real person
